subject: Long story about my account
body: Hello, I have been a customer for over six years and I want to explain the whole situation from the beginning because nobody seems to understand it. In 2019 I opened my account with my old work email address. Later I changed jobs and lost access to that email, so I asked support to change the email on my account, which they did in 2021. Since then everything was fine until last month, when I got a new phone and tried to sign in again. The app asked for a two-factor code that was sent to a phone number I no longer own. I contacted chat support and they told me to reset my password, which I did, but the two-factor prompt still goes to the old number. I then tried the web version on my laptop and it says my account is locked after too many attempts. I have also noticed that my profile picture and name were changed, which I did not do, and I am worried someone else may have access. My subscription renews next week and I cannot see or change my payment details. Please help me regain access to my account and update the phone number for two-factor authentication, and please check whether anybody else has logged in. I can provide my old invoices, the last four digits of my card and any other proof you need to confirm my identity.
